title: Peruvian-Style Duck Cazuela
description: A flavorful and aromatic Indian-inspired stew made with tender duck, peruvian spices and crispy confit potatoes.
instructions: Heat the duck fat in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Add the duck leg and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the Peruvian Cazuela Spice Mix and cook for 1 minute.
Add the tomato and cook until the mixture is heated through, about 5 minutes.
Add 1 cup of water and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Add the confit potatoes and cook for an additional 10 minutes.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped cilantro.
